cases.source_commitment: Episodic memory is past-oriented and characterized through personally experienced past events, subjective time, self, and autonoetic awareness.
cases.membership_kind: bounded temporal-state support; not a complete theory of episodic memory
cases.boundary: The coarse quotient retains past-directed temporal dependence while omitting the source's richer self/awareness/system structure.

anti_overclaim: Source compatibility means the coarse claim is a weaker consequence of each frozen reviewed representation, not that either author endorses the cross-source equivalence.
The audit does not establish that temporal implementation is irrelevant to capacity identity.
The audit does not turn positive coarse overlap into evidence that conflict monitoring and episodic memory are one capacity.
If the inquiry is temporal implementation rather than generic cross-time dependence, the fine representation may be preferable.
